title: Regime Audit Decision
description: LLM regime-auditor skill output: trustworthiness verdict for current regime detection.

status.description: trustworthy: per_regime_metrics may be used for verdict decisions. needs_retune: re-validate the detector before using per_regime_metrics. unusable: record in KB.

affected_symbols_timeframes.description: Symbol_timeframe pairs affected by this decision, e.g. ['BTCUSDT_1h'].

ungated_escape_eligible.description: Per A2.1: true when pooled IC ~ 0 or ungated backtest supports signal_bad_everywhere independent of regime partition.

ungated_escape_rationale.description: Evidence used to reach signal_bad_everywhere without trusting the regime partition.

retune_attempted.description: If true and status is still not trustworthy, orchestrator switches to ungated-only instead of pausing.
